poc_summary: Custom poc.js (adapted from reporter's testcase, evidence/candidate_03 and the official jit-test bug-2003588.js): creates Debugger `y` over global `x`, sets y.x = y, installs onDebuggerStatement handler that calls nukeAllCCWs() then wraps w.environment.getVariable("x") in a try/catch (printing CAUGHT/NO_EXCEPTION then DONE so the script's own JS-level exit path is always clean/exit 0 unless the process is killed by a native crash first), then triggers the debugger statement inside a `with` block via x.eval + x.f(y). Same poc.js and run command (`./obj-verify-js/dist/bin/js "$INPUT"`, default) used unmodified across pre_intro, post_intro, post_benign.
explanation: pre_intro (parent 9108500bb368): exit=0, clean. Output: "CAUGHT: TypeError: can't access dead object" then "DONE" — the CCW was properly nuked by nukeAllCCWs() and the subsequent access throws a well-formed, catchable JS exception; no crash, no sanitizer report. post_intro (9bd0056bb97a, the labelled intro commit): exit=134, crashed. AddressSanitizer reports a SEGV (write to address 0) with stack MOZ_CrashSequence -> JS::Compartment::wrap (vm/Compartment-inl.h:105) -> js::CrossCompartmentWrapper::get (proxy/CrossCompartmentWrapper.cpp:184) -> Proxy::getInternal/get -> GetProperty -> with_GetProperty -> DebugEnvironmentProxyHandler::getMaybeSentinelValue -> ... This exactly matches the reporter's own gdb backtrace in the Bugzilla report (same functions and same source lines: Compartment-inl.h:105, CrossCompartmentWrapper.cpp:184, EnvironmentObject.cpp with_GetProperty). The crash happens natively inside the engine before any JS-level try/catch can intervene, confirming the regression: commit 9bd0056bb97a special-cased NukeCrossCompartmentWrappers() to skip nuking CCWs that point at the Debugger object, but did not give js::AllowNewWrapper() the same exception, so Compartment::wrap()'s invariant (that an existing live wrapper and the "already nuked" gate agree) is violated, producing corrupted/incoherent wrapper state and a use-after-free-style crash (null-pointer dereference inside the release-assert path) when the proxy get path runs. post_benign (fix 0264cf850afd, mechanically composed companion): exit=0, clean. Output: "NO_EXCEPTION" then "DONE" — getVariable("x") now succeeds without throwing and without crashing, i.e., AllowNewWrapper() was updated to match the nuke exception, restoring Compartment::wrap()'s invariant. The same reproducer (poc.js, same command) yields: clean pre_intro -> sanitizer-crash post_intro (matching the reported bug's exact backtrace) -> clean post_benign, confirming both introduction and the benign fix as labelled.
